question: Indicative planning was adopted in India during the _______ Five-Year Plan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eighth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Indicative Planning in India was first introduced in the eighth Five-Year Plan.
 
• Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992 - 1997):
 
 
• It adopted Indicative Planning in India.
 
• A form of economic planning, Indicative planning is implemented by a state to solve the issue of imperfect information in the market and mixed economies.
 
• This is done to increase economic performance.
 
• Indicative Planning was first attempted in France.
 
• India's Eighth Five-Year Plan mentions that planning would have to be reoriented so as to make it indicative.​
